design_notes: Use a single accent colour (e.g., #003366) for table headers, pull-quote rule, and sidebar border.
Financials table: right-align all number columns; use parentheses for negative values.
Industry snapshot: render as a three-stat strip with a proportion split bar below; no growth bars since only two CAGR figures are available.
Pull-quote: set in a larger serif size (e.g., 18pt) with a hairline rule above and below, centred or left-aligned with a vertical rule.
Sidebar: box with a thin border, background tint at 5% of accent colour, body text at 10pt.

industry_snapshot.after_paragraph: The Indian specialty chemicals market (excluding agrochemicals and dyestuff) was estimated at approximately ₹1,000 billion in FY2017
industry_snapshot.rationale: Gives the reader a quick, visual sense of the market size, growth trajectory, and fragmentation — the three most important industry facts for evaluating a small-cap specialty chemicals IPO.
industry_snapshot.split_bar_note: Small and medium enterprises hold 70–75% market share. [^drhp-p94]

pull_quotes.after_paragraph: The company has not entered into long-term or definitive agreements with its customers
pull_quotes.quote: The company reported negative cash flows from operations of ₹349.75 lakh in FY2017, a year when it reported a profit of ₹174.82 lakh.
pull_quotes.rationale: The single most striking number in the filing — profit without cash — and the report's strongest risk signal.
